implementedInvariants: Provider evidence uses SHA-256 over strict canonical JSON-like content.
Re-sealing removes any previous top-level evidenceHash before hashing, so the final envelope is self-verifiable.
Observed-outcome recovery independently verifies the provider seal before any state transition.
Provider evidence is bound to operationId, projectId, capability, resourceUri, provider idempotency key, fence, operation content hash, target and exact inspection timestamp.
A valid seal from another operation or stale inspection cannot be replayed into the current recovery.
Historical fence semantics and no-exactly-once provider-effect posture remain unchanged.

riskRemoved: tampered provider payload re-sealed by COS
riskIntroduced: custom reconcilers that do not emit the selected sealed schema now fail closed
evidenceHash format moves from deterministic 128-bit identity hash to SHA-256
inspection time is now an exact recovery binding
newCouplings: observed-outcome recorder depends on selected provider evidence schema
provider evidence hashing depends on WebCrypto SHA-256
